No resale (eBay, specialist auction) comps for leg vices in the databases; only local Armitage/Gowans hammers, $55 to $260, median about $128. No new retail entry (antique, not a modern product).
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'blacksmith leg vice', 'post vice blacksmith', 'leg vice Fisher Wilkinson Peter Wright' (sold, last 12 months, Australia, note postage as these are heavy and ~20 kg+); also Facebook Marketplace/Gumtree 'leg vice' asking for ASKING only; Lawsons, Mossgreen and Burchardt/regional machinery auctions 'leg vice' results; Blacksmiths Guild of Australia sales page.
viewing_check: Look at the front jaw and box for a maker stamp (Peter Wright, Fisher, Hexham, Wilkinson), jaw width, whether the screw runs freely and the spring is intact, jaw faces not cracked or welded, and whether the mounting bracket or any ring is missing.
